senses.gloss:
Gona
of Bengal. father of Nārāyaṇa Upādhyāya (a. of Chāndogyapariśiṣṭaprakāśa, Intro. verses 9, 10).
See IHQ. XXII. p. 137.

Gonanda(na)
poet. eulogised by Rājaśekhara, Smv. p. 46 (no. 85); noted for Anuprāsa. Subhāṣitaratnakośa 87, 672. 1641 (Gotrānanda in Smv.).
See Kvs. Intro. p. 37; Subhāṣitaratnakośa, Intro. lxxvi.

Gonartaka
authority on Kāmaśāstra. ref. to by Kāñcīnātha in his C. on Ratirahasya, IO. 1240.
C.. Gonardīya.

Gonardīya
authority on gr. Q. by Patañjali in Mahābhāṣya under Sūtras I. 1. 28, 29. III. 1. 92 an. VII. 2. 101. Probably wrote in Kārikās.
See Ind. Ant. XV. 81 ff., XVI. 105.

Gonardīya
authority on Kāmaśāstra. ref. to by Vātsyāyana a. the author of a section on Bhāryādhikāra (Kāmasūtra, I. 1. 15). Q. by Vātsyāyana (ibid. I. i. 15. v. 25. IV. i. 4, 21. ii. 36, 42); by Kāñcīnātha in C. on Ratirahasya, IO. 1240; by Mallinātha on Raghuvam3śa XIX. 16, 29, 31 an. Kumārasambhava, VII. 95; by Rājaśekhara, Kāvyamīmām3sā, GOS. I. (1924). p. 26.
See also Sir Asutosh Com. Vol. III. Orientalia Pt. 2. p.. 197-205.

Gonāmika
(Pariśiṣṭa of Maitrāyaṇīyas).
Ed. by Raghu Vira, Journal of Vedic Studies, Vol. I. 1934, p.. 6-12.
